---
title: "Acknowledgements"
---

The MISP User Guide is a collaborative effort involving contributors to [MISP](https://github.com/MISP), including:

- Belgian Ministry of Defence (CERT)
- [CIRCL Computer Incident Response Center Luxembourg](https://www.circl.lu/)
- Iklody IT Solutions
- [NATO NCIRC](http://www.ncirc.nato.int/)
- Cthulhu Solutions
- [CERT-EU](https://cert.europa.eu)

We also thank the many other contributors, especially those who participated in the [MISP hackathons](https://github.com/MISP/MISP/wiki/Hackathon).
Their shared experience helps turn the platform's features into guidance that other users can apply.

The guide benefits from people who write and review chapters, report unclear instructions, test examples, update screenshots, draw diagrams, and improve the language and accessibility of the documentation.
These contributions matter whether they arrive as a small correction, a detailed issue, a review, or a new chapter.

The [repository's contributor history](https://github.com/MISP/misp-book/graphs/contributors) records contributions made through Git commits.
It does not capture every discussion, report, or piece of feedback that has helped improve the book.
Credits and source licenses for particular examples, diagrams, and adaptations are retained alongside that material.

To take part, see [How to Contribute](../contributing/index.qmd).
